题目.题目1:
【听力】听录音，回答问题：老师让学生怎么做？
听：The teacher asked us to work independently.
A. 独立完成
B. 两人合作
C. 回家做
D. 问家长
题目.题目2:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：You should finish the homework ______.
A. independently
B. independent
C. independence
D. depend
题目.题目3:
【选词填空】从 independent、independently 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
题干：The little boy is very ______.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目4:
【适当形式填空】用所给单词的适当形式填空。
题干：The country won its ______ in 1776. (independently)
考点：词性转换
题目.题目5:
【改错】句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
题干：He can think more independent now.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：Which phrase means about the same as "independently"?
A. together
B. with help
C. on one's own
D. at once
考点：易混
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：She can now do the work ______ than before.
A. most independently
B. independently more
C. more independently
D. more independent
考点：变形
题目.答案:
【1】A（独立完成）
讲解：work independently 独立工作。
【2】A（independently）
讲解：修饰动词 finish 用副词 independently。
【3】independent
讲解：be 后面接形容词 independent。
【4】independence
讲解：its 后面接名词 independence。
【5】independent → independently
讲解：修饰动词 think 用副词。
【6】C（on one's own）
讲解：independently = on one's own 独立地。
【7】C（more independently）
讲解：than 提示比较级，副词用 more independently。
